user.title: Choose the board
user.description: These are the Tasmota boards announcing themselves on your broker. Pick the one with the IR emitters.

manual.title: Enter the topic
manual.description: Use the value of Topic in the board's MQTT configuration. Leave FullTopic alone unless you changed it on the board.

abort.already_configured: This board is already set up.
abort.mqtt_unavailable: MQTT is not available. Set up the MQTT integration first.

init.title: Appliances
init.description: An appliance is a name plus the emitter pointed at it. Set it once here and you never type an emitter number again.

add.title: Add an appliance
add.description: Use the same name you will pass as 'device' when learning and sending.

remove.title: Remove an appliance
remove.description: The codes it learned are kept until you delete them with remote.delete_command.

add_climate.title: Add an air conditioner
add_climate.description: Name it and say which emitter points at it. The vendor and the model are read from your own remote in the next step.

learn_climate.title: Point the remote at the board
learn_climate.description: Press any key on the remote of '{name}' while this window is open. The firmware decodes the whole frame, so the vendor, the model and the supported modes come from the unit itself. There is nothing to look up in a manual.

remove_command.title: Delete a learned command
remove_command.description: Pick the command you learned wrong. Its button disappears with it, and you can learn it again from scratch.

abort.no_appliances: No appliance has been added yet.
abort.no_commands: Nothing has been learned on this board yet.

error.no_hvac_frame: No air conditioner frame was decoded. Press a key on the remote of the unit, pointed at the receiver, one press on its own. A remote that is not an air conditioner will not work here: use 'Add an appliance' for those.
